result.summary: Several visual and data-display bugs: a restaurant shows €NaN delivery, the last Fastest card title is clipped, category chips overflow the screen, and a promo card is cut off at the bottom.

issues.description: Smash Bros Burgers displays “€NaN delivery” instead of a valid price.
issues.suggestion: Guard against missing/invalid delivery fees and show a fallback such as “Free” or a real amount; never render NaN.

issues.description: The third “Fastest near you” card title is truncated (“Trattoria Piccol”) with no ellipsis or wrap, so the restaurant name is incomplete.
issues.suggestion: Allow two-line titles, add an ellipsis, or give cards enough width so full names remain readable.

issues.description: The bottom pizza promo card is cut off by the tab bar, hiding the restaurant name and details.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom padding/safe-area inset so the last card fully clears the navigation bar, or make the list scroll further.

issues.description: Category chips overflow the right edge (“Healthy” is clipped), with no fade or peek to indicate more categories.
issues.suggestion: Add horizontal scroll padding and a fade/overflow indicator so users can see there are more filters.
